10+ years of progressive enterprise applications or technology experience.

Experience managing complex enterprise application portfolios and vendors.

Top Aces moves from fragmented applications and manual workarounds toward a simplified, integrated and resilient enterprise application ecosystem that improves mission readiness, operational efficiency and global scalability.

This is an opportunity to shape the enterprise application landscape of a growing global aerospace and defense organization. You will influence major technology and business-process decisions and build an Enterprise Applications capability designed for the company's next stage of growth.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Revenue Operations (B2B SaaS) based in Canada.

We are seeking a commercially minded Revenue Operations leader to transform sales strategy into consistent, measurable execution within a growing B2B SaaS environment.

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will own the operating framework that drives pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and revenue performance.

You will work closely with experienced sales professionals and cross-functional leaders to improve execution, strengthen accountability, and accelerate sustainable growth.

A key priority will be introducing AI-enabled sales workflows that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, and streamline commercial operations.

You will also develop scalable processes and performance metrics that provide leadership with reliable insights into revenue performance and growth opportunities.

Combining strategic thinking with hands-on operational leadership, you will help turn commercial priorities into repeatable behaviors across a distributed sales organization.

This is an opportunity to shape the revenue engine of an expanding international SaaS business while having direct visibility and influence at the executive level.

Accountabilities

Revenue Operations Strategy and Execution: Translate the CRO's commercial strategy into clear priorities, actionable plans, measurable objectives, and defined ownership. Build and maintain the operating framework that ensures consistent execution across the revenue organization.
Sales Operating Cadence: Establish and manage recurring reviews covering pipeline health, forecasting, deal progression, account planning, and commercial commitments. Ensure expectations are clear, actions are tracked, and follow-through remains consistent.
Performance Management and Accountability: Reinforce revenue KPIs through regular performance reviews, coaching, and structured follow-up. Identify execution gaps, address recurring issues, remove obstacles, and encourage accountability across experienced sales professionals.
Account Planning and Revenue Expansion: Establish practical account-planning standards and coach sales teams on developing actionable plans. Build repeatable land-and-expand strategies that identify growth opportunities across existing clients, brands, retail banners, geographic regions, and product offerings.
Pipeline and Forecast Management: Develop a reliable, data-driven view of pipeline creation, coverage, deal risks, forecast accuracy, conversion rates, sales velocity, and win/loss trends. Identify emerging risks and translate insights into clear commercial actions.
Revenue KPI Framework: Own the revenue performance scorecard, defining and monitoring leading and lagging indicators related to pipeline generation, productivity, quota attainment, expansion bookings, and sales effectiveness. Ensure reporting definitions are consistent and trusted by leadership.
Territory and Capacity Planning: Partner with the CRO to develop coverage strategies, territory structures, and resource allocation plans that align sales capacity with market opportunities and business growth objectives.
Financial and Incentive Planning: Collaborate with Finance on quota setting, sales compensation structures, incentive design, and financial modeling to encourage the right commercial behaviors and support go-to-market objectives.
AI-Enabled Sales Transformation: Lead the adoption of AI-powered workflows across account planning, prospect research, opportunity management, deal inspection, and forecasting. Identify opportunities to improve seller productivity and measure the impact of new tools and processes.
Sales Process and Enablement: Develop and document practical sales processes, playbooks, and operating standards. Reinforce adoption through coaching, performance reviews, feedback, and consistent field execution.
Systems and Analytics Collaboration: Work with Salesforce and analytics specialists to define business requirements, improve CRM data quality, and ensure systems provide actionable insights. This is an operational leadership position rather than a hands-on Salesforce administration role.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Client Success, Finance, and Product teams to improve alignment throughout the customer lifecycle and ensure commercial priorities are consistently executed.
Executive Partnership: Create operational leverage for the CRO by improving visibility, reducing administrative follow-up, and allowing sales leadership to focus more effectively on strategic decisions, coaching, and closing key opportunities.
Performance Measurement: Establish initial performance benchmarks within the first 90 days and define measurable improvement targets for forecast accuracy, sales-cycle duration, win rates, account-plan coverage, and overall revenue execution.

Requirements

Significant professional experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Excellence, or a comparable commercial execution leadership role, ideally within an enterprise B2B SaaS environment.
Proven track record of improving sales execution, revenue performance, and organizational effectiveness through practical operating frameworks rather than simply maintaining systems or producing reports.
Strong hands-on experience with enterprise account planning, complex deal reviews, sales forecasting, pipeline management, and land-and-expand strategies.
Deep understanding of B2B SaaS sales processes, including enterprise selling, pipeline development, opportunity qualification, customer expansion, and revenue retention.
Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret complex commercial data, identify performance trends, uncover risks, and translate insights into practical recommendations.
Working fluency with Salesforce and CRM-based reporting, with the ability to define system requirements and collaborate effectively with technical and analytics specialists. Salesforce administration experience is an advantage but is not essential.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing revenue KPIs, performance scorecards, forecasting frameworks, and repeatable sales processes.
Experience introducing AI-enabled tools or workflows into commercial operations, with an understanding of how automation and AI can improve sales productivity and decision-making.
Proven ability to influence experienced sales professionals and senior leaders without relying on direct reporting authority, building trust and accountability through credibility, sound judgment, and consistency.
Strong leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to develop others, establish clear expectations, and encourage a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex data, commercial insights, and strategic recommendations to both frontline teams and executive stakeholders.
Strong process orientation, with the ability to bring structure and repeatability to evolving or ambiguous business environments without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
Highly adaptable and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced, growing organization.
A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and responsibility for measurable business outcomes.
Experience in vertical SaaS, retail technology, specialty retail, or private-equity-backed organizations is an advantage, although strong commercial judgment and the ability to learn new markets are equally valued.
Willingness to undertake moderate national and international travel as required.

Benefits

Competitive compensation: Starting base salary of CAD $180,000 per year, plus a 20% performance bonus at target.
Fully remote work: Work remotely with flexibility in your daily schedule.
Comprehensive healthcare: Employer-paid health benefits, including dental care, prescription drug coverage, and a Health Spending Account.
Retirement savings: RRSP matching program, with additional support for first-time home buyers (subject to program conditions).
Professional development: Company-funded training and opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
Work-life balance: Extended long weekends and additional days off for religious observances.
Employee recognition: Spotlight Recognition Bonus Program celebrating individual contributions and achievements.
Referral incentives: Employee Referral Program rewarding successful candidate recommendations.
Well-being support: Access to a dedicated Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
Leadership exposure: Direct collaboration with the CRO and senior leadership, with meaningful influence over commercial strategy and business performance.
International collaboration: Opportunities to work with talented colleagues and leading retail brands across global markets.
Inclusive workplace: A collaborative environment built on trust, flexibility, diversity, and professional growth.

We are seeking an experienced corporate tax leader to oversee income tax and indirect tax compliance, reporting, and strategic tax planning within a large and complex organization.

In this senior leadership role, you will drive corporate tax strategy, ensure regulatory compliance, and manage tax accounting policies and procedures in alignment with applicable legislation and professional standards.

You will lead tax planning initiatives, oversee tax provisions and financial reporting, and identify opportunities to optimize the organization's effective tax rate.

Working closely with senior executives, finance teams, external auditors, and government authorities, you will provide strategic guidance on complex tax matters.

You will also manage tax audits and disputes while ensuring that evolving legislative and regulatory requirements are effectively integrated into business processes.

As the leader of a dedicated tax team, you will foster professional development, collaboration, and operational excellence.

This opportunity offers the chance to influence enterprise-wide financial decisions while contributing to the long-term sustainability and governance of a major Canadian organization.

Accountabilities

Corporate Tax Compliance: Lead the corporate income tax and indirect tax compliance functions, overseeing the preparation, review, and submission of all statutory and regulatory filings, supporting documentation, and related reporting requirements.
Tax Audits and Dispute Resolution: Direct the resolution of issues arising from government tax audits and inquiries, working with the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA), provincial revenue authorities, and the United States Internal Revenue Service (IRS).
Strategic Tax Planning: Coordinate and oversee the organization's Tax Centre of Excellence, focusing on proactive tax planning, effective tax management, and opportunities to reduce the overall effective tax rate.
Corporate Tax Strategy: Lead the tax component of the corporate business plan, including tax provisions, effective tax rate calculations, financial comparisons, and strategic tax assessments.
Tax Accounting and Financial Reporting: Oversee the preparation and review of tax provisions, deferred tax calculations, and effective tax rate analyses in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
External Audit Support: Collaborate with external auditors and provide tax-related expertise and documentation throughout quarterly and annual financial reporting processes.
Regulatory Monitoring: Monitor changes in tax legislation, professional practices, and accounting and reporting standards, ensuring that relevant corporate policies, procedures, and systems are regularly updated.
Internal Controls and Risk Management: Manage internal control documentation relating to corporate income and indirect taxes as part of the Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) certification process.
Confidential Tax Matters: Ensure the appropriate and discreet handling of sensitive tax-related information, including employee benefits during collective bargaining, executive compensation, senior management benefits, and the tax implications of new products and services.
Team Leadership and Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of tax professionals, promoting collaboration, open communication, knowledge sharing, professional growth, and effective succession planning.
Executive Advisory: Translate complex tax issues into practical recommendations and clear guidance for senior leaders and stakeholders across different business functions.

Requirements

Colliers Project Leaders is a team committed to projects that make a difference in communities and for the people who live there.

Make cities more livable

Build a sustainable future

If this kind of work resonates with you, you’re in the right place

Your role

Lead with purpose. Innovate with impact.

We are seeking a Sector Director to lead growth and strengthen Colliers Project Leaders' position in the Infrastructure sector.

As a Sector Director, you will be accountable for driving sector growth, achieving sales targets, developing strategic client relationships, and building the capabilities needed to expand our market presence. Working across a dynamic matrix organization, you will collaborate with Business Unit leaders, Business Development, Practice Excellence, and practitioners across the business to identify opportunities, lead strategic pursuits, and deliver on our sector growth strategy.

As a recognized leader within your sector, you will develop and execute multi-year growth strategies, manage strategic relationships with new clients, and identify opportunities to integrate our services to address evolving client needs. You will bring a strong understanding of infrastructure market trends, client priorities, procurement environments, and capital project challenges to position Colliers Project Leaders for success.

A key part of your role will be developing our people and strengthening our sector capabilities. You will coach practitioners in consultative sales, account management, and client engagement, while building a network of Infrastructure champions across our Business Units.

A natural collaborator, you thrive in a matrix environment and excel at aligning diverse stakeholders around common goals. You take ownership of organizational priorities and initiatives, translating them into meaningful results across teams and projects. Committed to continuous improvement, you actively seek innovative ways to enhance performance, strengthen operations, and create value for clients.

You will elevate our brand through thought leadership, industry engagement, and impactful client relationships, supported by a strong and growing network across the sector. If you’re ready to influence direction, strengthen market position, and make a visible impact, this is your opportunity to lead and grow at scale.

Responsibilities

Growth & Business Development

Lead the development and execution of the regional Infrastructure sector growth plan, translating market intelligence, client needs, and emerging opportunities into actionable priorities and achieving annual sales targets.
Drive net new business by identifying priority markets, prospective clients, strategic accounts, and opportunities to expand Colliers Project Leaders' presence in the Infrastructure sector, including but not limited to; major projects, transportation, utilities, water and wastewater, energy, and other major capital project markets.
Lead and support pursuits, bringing sector expertise, client insight, and commercial acumen to strengthen our competitive positioning.
Support client discovery, prospecting and competitive pursuits, bringing sector-specific knowledge and relationships to position Colliers Project Leaders for success.
Build and strengthen relationships with key Infrastructure organizations, clients and industry partners.
Understand Infrastructure client buying and procurement behaviours and use those insights to help strengthen our positioning and approach.
Monitor sales pipeline health, maintain accurate and consistent sales information, and support effective opportunity management and forecasting.
Collaborate across regions where opportunities, clients or relationships extend beyond regional boundaries.

Strategy

Direct the development of the Infrastructure sector business plan, with input from key stakeholders, and lead its implementation to achieve annual sector sales targets.
Maintain a strong understanding of trends, challenges and emerging opportunities within the Infrastructure sector and translate those insights into regional growth priorities.
Contribute regional market intelligence and perspective to the broader Infrastructure sector strategy.

Sector Leadership & Capability Development

Demonstrate and act as a role model and influencer of our values.
Serve as an Infrastructure sector resource and advisor to Business Unit leaders, project teams and practitioners, sharing market knowledge and client insight to support growth and delivery.
Coach practitioners and leadership on sales strategies and tactics, develop Infrastructure sector champions within Business Units to expand sector expertise, strengthen client relationships, and build the qualifications and capabilities needed to pursue new opportunities.
Connect project teams, clients and Infrastructure experts across the organization to share knowledge, qualifications and perspectives.
Establish and strengthen Colliers Project Leaders' reputation through thought leadership, industry engagement, conference participation, speaking opportunities, and client engagement.

Management

Lead regional sales planning for Infrastructure, including opportunities to integrate services and capabilities across Colliers Project Leaders.
Clarify and anticipate Infrastructure sector trends, articulate how they affect clients, and develop approaches to capitalize on opportunities or respond to changing market conditions.
Identify the expertise, qualifications and capacity required to pursue and successfully deliver Infrastructure opportunities
Develop Infrastructure sector champions within the Business Units to broaden sector knowledge, relationships and qualifications.
Work with key experts across the organization to build Infrastructure credentials, capability and market profile.

Delivery Excellence, Quality & Risk

Support a culture of quality and consistent adherence to our Sales system and processes.
Drive the integrity, accuracy and consistency of Infrastructure sector and account information to support informed decision-making, pursuit planning and operational excellence.
Identify material delivery, contractual, and commercial risks, provide advice to Business Unit leadership, and escalate significant issues appropriately.
Support teams in understanding client requirements and positioning appropriate commercial terms to protect client outcomes and business interests.

Qualifications

Ten (10) years’ experience as a practitioner (consultant or client side) in the sector is considered an asset. Minimum five (5) years experience in sales is required
Practiced in consultative sales; listening to clients, identifying opportunities, knowing what is required to close the sale, and seeing the sale through
Professional industry credentials relevant and specific to the sector is considered a strong asset
Is a known industry player and leader across the sector regionally and is well connected with key organizations and clients (target and existing) in the sector
An established network of sector contacts regionally and involvement with applicable sector industry and trade associations
Excellent verbal and written communication, facilitation and presentation skills for all levels of our clients and our own organization including a proven ability to write winning proposals
The ability to project and maintain a positive outlook and demonstrate an energetic disposition
Willingness to travel as required locally and within region

A comprehensive onboarding experience

Join our team of difference-makers and help shape the growth of dynamic communities.
